Respondent Counsel for the Applicant : Mr. Aditya Pratap Singh,
 Advocate Counsel for the Respondent : Mr. Pradeep Lohani, Brief  Holder Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma,J.

This Application has been filed for anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.505 of 2025, registered at Police Station Gangnahar, District Haridwar under Sections 120B, 419, 420, 467, 468 and Section 471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2. An anticipatory bail application was filed by the applicant before the Sessions Court.

Learned Ist Additional District & Sessions Judge, Roorkee, District Haridwar has rejected the said Application (ABA No.553 of 2025) on 07.11.2025.
3.

sentences.text: According to the First Information Report dated 15.10.2025, a registered sale-deed of the informant's plot was executed on 08.06.2022.
Her (informant) forged signature was made on the said sale-deed.

4. Heard Mr. Aditya Pratap Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Mr. Pradeep Lohani,
learned Brief Holder for the respondent.
5.
Mr. Aditya Pratap Singh, Advocate, contended that the applicant is only a witness to the said sale-deed.
He had signed the sale-deed trusting Sandeep, the co-accused.
He had asked the applicant to be a witness to the said sale- deed.
Applicant is not a convicted person.
He is a permanent resident of District Haridwar, therefore, there is no possibility of his absconding.

sentences.text: Mr. Pradeep Lohani, Brief Holder has sought three weeks' time to file objection to the anticipatory bail application.
7. Time is granted.

8. Having heard the learned counsel for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case, as an ad- interim measure, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the applicant-Kaushal Kumar Sahay alias Sunny, he shall be released on interim bail on executing a personal bond of Rs.30,000/-
and two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Officer, subject to the following conditions:-
(i) Applicant shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency and he shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
(ii) Applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of this case.
(iii) Applicant shall not leave the country without the previous permission of this Court.
9. List on 18.03.2026 for hearing on the anticipatory bail application.

__ ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
